name: modify-node-status-v1
description: determines which subjects can modify the nodes/status subresource, letting them set or remove node labels and so bypass the nodeSelector and nodeAffinity scheduling constraints that keep sensitive workloads away from untrusted nodes
remediation: Remove update and patch on nodes/status from the cluster role, and grant them only to the components that reconcile node state, such as the kubelet and the node lifecycle controller. Avoid wildcard resources and */status entries in cluster roles bound to workloads or users, and keep the NodeRestriction admission plugin enabled so kubelets cannot relabel their own node.
